definitions.explanation: Visually striking and beautiful in a lively, colorful way. Describes things that are eye-catching and full of vitality, whether physical appearance, atmosphere, or lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {華|はな}やかな{衣装|いしょう}を{身|み}につける。
{舞台|ぶたい}は{華|はな}やかな{雰囲気|ふんいき}に{包|つつ}まれていた。
examples.english: The stage was enveloped in a brilliant atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{芸能界|げいのうかい}という{華|はな}やかな{世界|せかい}で{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active in the glamorous world of show business.

notes: Can also be written {華やか|はなやか} (without な when used as a standalone adjective stem). The adverb form is {華|はな}やかに. Common collocations: {華|はな}やかな{経歴|けいれき} (brilliant career), {華|はな}やかな{世界|せかい} (glamorous world), {華|はな}やかな{色合|いろあ}い (vivid colors). The opposite nuance is {地味|じみ} (plain, subdued).
